name: LTV-300
summary: The LTV-300 is a free light transport vehicle in RallyDrop.
role: Use the LTV-300 to move the team. This vehicle has no weapon.
fun_facts: The LTV-300 is the only RallyDrop vehicle exposed to free access.

name: MBT-800
summary: The MBT-800 is a heavy tank with high health and four weapons.
role: Use the MBT-800 when the team needs armor and heavy weapons. This tank is slow.
fun_facts: The MBT-800 has four vehicle weapons.

name: MH-60 Blackhawk
summary: The MH-60 Blackhawk is an aircraft that can carry a large team.
role: Use it for long-distance transport. Select a safe landing area because the aircraft has low health.
fun_facts: The Blackhawk carries a large squad but has a much smaller health pool than armored RallyDrop vehicles.

name: MH-60 Blackhawk (Pilot Minigun)
summary: This MH-60 Blackhawk has a minigun for the pilot.
role: Use it to transport the team and attack from the air. The aircraft has low health.
fun_facts: The pilot-minigun variant gives the pilot a weapon and keeps the Blackhawk transport function.

name: MIB831 Mastiff
summary: The MIB831 Mastiff is an armored vehicle with one weapon.
role: Use the Mastiff to move the team and attack enemies from the ground.
fun_facts: The Mastiff's health value is higher than the MBT-800's.

name: MTG-92
summary: The MTG-92 is a light vehicle with one weapon.
role: Use the MTG-92 when you need speed and a mounted weapon.
fun_facts: The MTG-92, MTP-92, and MTV-92 are in the same light RallyDrop family. They have different speeds, seat quantities, and mounted weapons.

name: MTP-92
summary: The MTP-92 is a light vehicle with one weapon.
role: Use the MTP-92 for fast movement and mounted weapon fire.
fun_facts: The MTP-92's forward speed is slightly higher than the MTG-92's.

name: MTV-92
summary: The MTV-92 is a fast light vehicle with one weapon.
role: Use the MTV-92 when you need speed. Do not use it as an armored vehicle because it has low health.
fun_facts: The MTV-92 has the highest forward speed of the MT-92 trio.

name: PA Humvee (MG)
summary: The PA Humvee (MG) is a transport vehicle with a machine gun.
role: Use it to move a small team and attack enemies with the machine gun.
fun_facts: The Humvee MG is faster than both JLTV variants in forward speed.

name: PA JLTV (Cannon)
summary: The PA JLTV (Cannon) is an armored vehicle with a cannon.
role: Use this vehicle when the team needs armor and a cannon.
fun_facts: Both JLTV variants share the same health value.

name: PA JLTV (MG)
summary: The PA JLTV (MG) is an armored vehicle with a machine gun.
role: Use this vehicle to move a small team and attack enemies with the machine gun.
fun_facts: The machine-gun JLTV is a little faster than the cannon JLTV in forward speed.

name: PA467 Centurion
summary: The PA467 Centurion is a heavy vehicle with high health and three weapons.
role: Use the Centurion when the team needs armor, weapons, and more speed than the MBT-800.
fun_facts: The Centurion has the same health value as the MBT-800 but a higher forward speed.

name: Panzer IV
summary: The Panzer IV is a tank from the RALLYDROP: WWII gamepass.
role: Use the Panzer IV when the team needs a tank with four weapons.
fun_facts: The Panzer IV appears in-game as Panzer IV Ausf. G.

name: T-34
summary: The T-34 is a tank from the RALLYDROP: WWII gamepass.
role: Use the T-34 when the team needs a tank with three weapons.
fun_facts: The T-34 appears in-game as T-34-76.
